parsed.notes: Table lists Requirement before Actual. Leverage limit steps up to 4.50 and FCCR minimum steps down to 1.00 for four quarters after a designated acquisition (Third Amendment, June 8, 2026). Consolidated leverage ratio definition allows netting up to $100 million of unrestricted cash. Riverpoint Medical acquisition closed July 23, 2026 (after period end), raising gross debt from $238.8M to $854.8M, so post-quarter leverage will be materially higher. Leverage-based pricing margins and the 0.25% margin widening above 3.75x are rate-setting terms, not separate covenants.
